name: resistance band anti rotation dead bug
description: A dead bug with a band pulling you sideways, so your core works hard to keep your torso from twisting.
instructions: Anchor a band at the side and lie on your back, holding the band above your chest with both hands.
Raise your knees to a tabletop position.
Brace your core so the band does not pull you sideways.
Slowly extend one leg and the opposite arm back.
Keep your lower back flat on the floor.
